palette.forbidden: Green, mint, teal and green-tinted neutral surfaces

typography.foreground: Native DOM, independent of all optical filters

geometry.contour: Periodic uniform cubic B-spline, C2 continuous
geometry.endpointRule: Match local osculating-circle centers, not constant whole-end spacing
geometry.endpointGap: Derived from displayed geometry and rail end radius, never a fixed universal pixel margin

motion.pointer: Continuous value and position, no display-precision quantization
motion.release: Critically damped spring only after release; preserve position when re-grabbed
motion.reduced: System preference has priority; decorative motion and overshoot stop

rendering.smallControls: Actual browser backdrop through SVG displacement + same-path edge and shadow
rendering.largeVolume: Analytic 2.5D environment height field; not arbitrary DOM refraction or a physical 3D volume
